title: Dino Island
overview:
Years ago, an expedition found a handful of surviving dinosaurs in an underground cave in Iceland. Moved to an island in the south, they took to the warm climate and quickly multiplied. Then it was discovered that music could control them, and a school was founded to train dinosaur tamers.

Emiri dreams of becoming a dinosaur tamer, and she enrolls at the school along with her twin sister Anje. Follow their story through colorful manga-style scenes and pick what Emiri says and does from the choices that appear. Depending on your choices, familiar faces from Yumimi Mix may turn up along the way.

- Shuttle Mouse compatible
